grammar_focus: have 的用法(KS18)主考——have / have got 表'拥有'(own/possess 的替换)、have + 名词代替普通动词(have a look / a good time / a drink / a talk);pick up(拿起/学会/接人)、pick out(挑选)、tell the difference between(辨别)、as soon as(一…就…)(辅考·课文/难点①类)。美语差:散步/洗澡/休息/看一看 美语多用 take a walk / bath / rest / look(见关6对照)
scene: 在旧德里的集市里走了很长一段路后,我们在一个广场上停下来休息。过了一会儿,注意到广场另一边有个带着两个大筐的耍蛇人,便走过去看。他一见我们,就拿起一根缠满硬币的长管,掀开一个筐。他吹起一支曲子,我们才第一次看到那条蛇。蛇从筐里探出身子,随着管子的摆动而扭动。当耍蛇人突然吹起爵士乐和现代流行乐时,我们非常惊奇——那蛇却还是慢慢地“舞动”着。显然,它分辨不出印度音乐和爵士乐!

grammar_card.title: have 的用法:拥有 & have + 名词 = 做某事
grammar_card.intro: have / have got 可表'拥有'(替换 own / possess);还能 have + 名词来代替一个普通动词:have a look = 看一看,have a good time = 玩得开心,have a drink = 喝一杯。全用本课句子举例。

rows: He has (got) a new house.(拥有)
Have a look at this.(看一看)
I enjoyed myself at the party.
I had a good time at the party.(玩得开心)
He wanted to drink a glass of water.
He wanted to have a drink of water.(喝一杯)
We will talk about it tomorrow.
We will have a talk about it tomorrow.(谈一谈)

specialRules.rule: have got = have,都表'拥有',口语里 have got 更常见:He has got a new car.
美语差:散步/洗澡/休息/看一看,美语多用 take(take a walk / take a bath / take a rest / take a look);英式多用 have。
specialRules.mark: 美语常用 take a walk/bath

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — What happened when the snake charmer began to play jazz?
options: The snake kept 'dancing' slowly, unable to tell it from Indian music

passage: As we had had a long walk through one of the markets of Old Delhi, we stopped at a square to have a rest. After a time, we noticed a snake charmer with two large baskets at the other side of the square, so we went to have a look at him. As soon as he saw us, he picked up a long pipe which was covered with coins and opened one of the baskets. When he began to play a tune, we had our first glimpse of the snake. It rose out of the basket and began to follow the movements of the pipe. We were very much surprised when the snake charmer suddenly began to play jazz and modern pop songs. The snake, however, continued to 'dance' slowly. It obviously could not tell the difference between Indian music and jazz!

"He possesses a lot of money. = He ___ a lot of money."(表'拥有')
"He ___ got a new car."(表'拥有'的口语说法)
"I ___ got two large baskets."(表'拥有'的口语说法)
"We went to ___ a look at the snake charmer."(看一看)
stage5.stem_cn: 我们去看一看那个耍蛇人。

stage5.stem: "We ___ a good time at the party."(玩得开心)
stage5.stem_cn: 我们在聚会上玩得很开心。

stage5.stem: "He wanted to ___ a drink of water."(喝点水)
"Let's ___ a talk about it tomorrow."(谈一谈)

stage5.stem: "He ___ a long pipe covered with coins."(拿起)

stage5.stem: "Can you ___ between the two colors?"(辨别…之间的不同)
